The '''Manarai Hills''' was a district on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was one of the more affluent districts on the planet, with majority of the structures designed by the renowned [[Architect/Legends|architect]] [[Benits Stinex]].<ref name="sos">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>
